en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall corner towers and an arcade façade, fronted by a statue in a circular park. Flanking the cathedral are historic buildings and tree-lined paths. Printed Hungarian captions read "Üdvözlet Pécsről" (Greetings from Pécs) and "Székesegyház" (Cathedral). The reverse side has the Hungarian heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP", handwritten Hungarian text and address lines, a PÉCS postmark dated 1914, and a small printed publisher line at the bottom.
